items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: plus the things I did as a sideman with Cal Collins and Scott and Warren Vache and those things in Japan and so forth.

ctx.x: Yeah, because you have spent just a few nights doing solo piano, haven’t you?

Yeah. And my fingers are getting weary. Not that I’m going to be that much help to a small band, but if the guys — I love working with guitar, too. I love Cal Collins’ playing, I love Gray Sargent’s playing. And I like to be in a four man rhythm section with one or two horns. That’s what I’d like to sort of end up doing if I play.
The solo work you did, it was two different clubs you were at for quite a number of years, right? In the Boston area?
